fair_value_reason: P/E leg: 19-19.5x Oct-2027 NTM EPS of ~$24.7 (0.25 x FY27 $21.93 + 0.75 x FY28 ~$25.4 at +16%) = ~$470-480. FCF leg: ~$415-430 (FY27-28 FCF ~$11.5-12.5/ADR after $85-90B/$105B capex at a ~2.8-2.9% yield). Weighted ~0.75/0.25, that gives ~$455. It sits slightly above the agents' ~$452 average because agent_1's 5-year DCF ($353, 4% terminal) and agent_3's stacked haircut plus 18.5x look structurally low; no agent made a factual error large enough to move it further.

thesis_triggers.event: $330 is ~28% below spot, ~15x the verified $21.93 FY27 consensus and ~13.4x Oct-2027 NTM EPS, near the March 2026 lows ($314-338). A close there would most likely mean FY27 estimates are being cut (AI order pushouts at the top-2 customers, a GM reset below ~58%) or a Taiwan/Section 232 repricing. A 5.3% 10-year alone explains only ~1-1.5 turns of multiple.

supervisor_summary: The five round-2 forecasts have converged on a ~$470-480 median with a fat left tail: P(>=$459) is 0.49-0.54. My checks verified the rate backdrop (10-year 5.29% close, highest since 2002; T-bill 4.17%) and the rising FY27 consensus ($21.93, 9 up / 0 down). They could not settle the one input still in dispute, FY2028 growth (+12% to +18.5%), so I keep the mean ladder unchanged with low confidence. Fair value is ~$455 (~1% below spot) and the thesis breaks at $330 (~15x FY27): a fully priced quality compounder that is roughly a coin flip to be higher in a year.
key_drivers: FY27 consensus EPS $21.93/ADR (+30% on FY26 $16.93), revised up from $19.66 in 90 days with 9 up / 0 down; the stock trades at ~20.9x that.
FY28 growth is the biggest open input: agents range +12% to +18.5%, which spans ~$24-25 NTM EPS and ~+/-$12/ADR at 19x; there is no free consensus to settle it.
Rates: the 10-year closed at 5.29% on Sep 30 (highest close since 2002), the 3-month bill is at 4.17%, and the Fed hiked Sep 16. This caps the exit multiple at ~19-19.5x.
Capex steps up to ~$85-90B in 2027 (BofA $85B; UBS $90B via one secondary recap) and ~$105B in 2028, holding FY27 FCF to ~$11-12.5/ADR.
Taiwan/tariff tail: a 4-5% crash state; all agents rely on the same single Polymarket market (13% invasion by end-2027).
